Reads run events (RunEvent) of teams run in this console. hook and MCP observation events show up here too. Run history is read only.
text.수집 때 살펴볼 최근 Run 수. 공용 기록과 프로젝트 공간마다 따로 센: Number of recent runs to look at per collection. Counted separately for shared records and each project (older runs keep only what is already indexed).
text.실행 이벤트 형식(또는 글롭, 예: run.*) → 대응 규칙. 기본 대: Run event type (or glob, for example run.*) → mapping rule. Overrides the default map key by key.
text.로그에 보일 이 필드의 값. 틀(예: {type}) 또는 이벤트에서 읽어: Value of this field shown in the log. A template (for example {type}) or a rule that reads and maps a value from the event.
Location in the event to read the value from (for example /data/status).
text.읽은 값 → 보일 값(틀, 예: {node}). 없는 값은 없을 때 값을: Read value → shown value (template, for example {node}). Values not listed use the fallback value.
Value used when the read value isn't in the map (template). Leave empty to keep the read value.
Sender (a template or a rule that reads and maps a value from the event; empty means none).
Receiver (a template or a rule that reads and maps a value from the event; empty means none).
text.이 형식의 로그에 붙일 태그 목록. 항목은 글자 그대로의 태그 또는 목록: Tags to add to logs of this type. Each item is a literal tag or a build-from-list rule.
Makes one value for each element of a list in the event (empty values are left out).
Location of the list in the event to take elements from.
Value to make for each element (template, for example {./kind}) or a read-and-map rule.
Location to read the value from. ./key is relative to the list element, /key to the event.
Read value → shown value (template). Values not listed use the fallback value.
Value used when the read value isn't in the map (template). An empty value leaves the item out.
text.근거 이름 → 틀 또는 목록에서 만들기(값 여러 개, session·ca: Evidence name → template or build-from-list rule (several values; session and call_id are automatic).
text.로그가 가리키는 문서(틀 하나 또는 목록). 목록 위치를 주면 원소마다: Documents the log points to (one template or a list). With a list pointer, one is made for each element.
text.로그가 가리키는 문서 하나의 틀. 목록 위치를 주면 원소마다 문서 하나를: Template of one document the log points to. With a list pointer, one document is made for each element.
If set, makes a document for each element of this list (./key in the template is relative to the element).
Location of the duration (ms) of a finished span. If present, two events (start and end) are made.
Location of the node session id this event reports.
text.이 이벤트가 알리는 Run 작업 폴더의 위치. 그 뒤 같은 Run 로그의: Location of the run folder this event reports. It then becomes the project reference for later logs of the same run.
If true, events of this type aren't indexed.
text.앱에서 한 실행의 기록을 로그 화면에서도 보게 한다: Shows runs made in the app on the Logs screen too
Server administrator setting for when platform run history is collected into session logs.
text.실행 이벤트가 오면 이 시간 동안 모아 로그 수집을 한 번 예약한다(0: When run events arrive, gathers them for this long and schedules one log collection (0 = right away).
Path of the document (a template or a rule that reads and maps a value). If empty, the document is left out.
Kind of the document (a template or a rule that reads and maps a value). If empty, the default is used.
Relation to the document (a template or a rule that reads and maps a value). If empty, the default is used.
